title: Action speed
wikitext:
[[File:Action speed character screen.jpg|thumb|A character hexed with {{il|Temporal Chains}} has less action speed.]]
'''Action speed''' is a [[stat]] that determines how fast or slow a character performs actions, such as running, swinging a weapon, casting a spell, or recoiling from being stunned.

The total modifier to the player character's action speed can be viewed on the Character screen under the Defence tab.

==Mechanics==
A character's action speed determines the relative rate at which its animations play, thereby affecting the overall speed that their actions are performed.<ref name="Chilled ground vs tar" /><ref name="Brand activation frequency" /> All of the character's actions that have an animated component are affected by their action speed.<ref name="Slow" /> This includes moving, attacking and casting (including channelling), throwing traps and mines, shouting warcries, summoning totems, and recovering from stuns. 

Modifiers to action speed have a multiplicative effect on a character in conjunction with stats that affect the speed of specific actions, such as [[movement speed]], [[attack speed]], [[cast speed]] and [[stun recovery]].<ref name="Chilled ground vs tar" /> Action speed does not directly modify such stats.<ref name="Slow" /> This distinction is relevant for game mechanics that care about any discrete modifiers to those stats. For example, the brand activation frequency of {{il|Arcanist Brand}} is affected by modifiers to the character's cast speed; whereas it is not affected by modifiers to the character's action speed.<ref name="Brand activation frequency" />

Some monsters - mainly endgame and league bosses - have the hidden modifier {{ml|CannotBeSlowedBelowValueBosses|display=id}}, preventing their action speed from dropping below 50%.

===Action cap=== 
Because the game engine limits players to starting 1 action per server frame, or 30 actions per second, it is possible to reach a point at which speed stats are no longer useful. This is not a typical issue outside extreme cases. This only limits ''new'' actions: [[repeat]]ing animations do not count toward the limit, and [[channelling]] is unaffected by it entirely.<ref>https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/ll1y91/114_hits_flicker_strike_build/gnqj242/?context=4</ref>  

==Sources of action speed modifiers==
===Skill gems===
{{Query stat related skill gems
|type=active
|stat_id_query=%action%speed%
|stat_page=action speed
}}

The following skills from items affects action speed:
* {{sl|Summon Harbinger of Time}}
* {{sl|Summon Greater Harbinger of Time}}
* {{sl|id=GlimpseOfEternity}}
* {{sl|Arcane Wake}}

===Buffs===
* [[Acceleration Shrine]] (50% increased)
* {{stl|Tailwind}} (8% increased)
* {{stl|Slipstream}} (10% increased)
* [[List of Searing Exarch implicit modifiers|Searing Exarch implicit mods]] for boots ({{c|mod|ActionSpeedImplicitEldritchImplicit}}) (4-6% increased, 6-8% increased conditionally)

===Debuffs===
* {{stl|Chill}} is capped at 30% reduced action speed, or 40% with [[Shaper of Winter]]. {{il|Winterweave}} is capped at 30% increased action speed (or 40% with [[Shaper of Winter]] and ailment reflection).
* {{stl|Freeze}} is a 100% less action speed multiplier.
* {{stl|Petrified}} is a 100% less action speed multiplier. 
** Stone Gaze is a stacking debuff that applies 15% reduced action speed per stack. At 6 stacks, the target becomes Petrified.
* {{stl|Maddening Presence}} (10% reduced)
* Mania from {{psl|You're the crazy one!}} (2% reduced per stack; max 30%)
* "Temporal" [[monster modifier]] (25% reduced)

===Support gems===
{{Query stat related skill gems
|type=support
|stat_id_query=%action%speed%
|stat_page=action speed
}}

===Modifiers===
{{Query spawnable modifiers
|where=
  mod_stats.id LIKE "%action%speed%"
  AND mod_spawn_weights.value > 0
|spawn_weights=1
|generation_type=1
|q_orderBy=mods.domain ASC, mods.generation_type ASC, mods.id ASC, mods.required_level ASC
}}

===Unique items===
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables = item_stats
|join = item_stats._pageName=items._pageName
|where = 
    items.stat_text LIKE "%action%speed%"
 OR item_stats.id LIKE "%action%speed%"
|large=1
|stat=1
|level=1
}}

===Passive skills===
{{Query passive skills
|where=
    passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%action%speed%"
OR passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%freeze%nearby%"
}}
